title: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password | TechCrunch
summary: Password manager 1Password on Thursday launched a new tool by which users can allow agents to log into their personal accounts on their behalf, without the agent ever having access to a user’s credentials.
